title: Module 1 Portfolio
hero_note:
3 questions.
Use your group work.
Show your own thinking.
intro: Start with the course question. Tap Module 1 lens only when you want a more specific version.

connect.lens: Connect two of these: arrangement/rectangle, table, equation, graph. What does each show about the same situation?
connect.evidence: Use your screenshot + one detail from your quick reflection.

justify.lens: Make a claim about product, roots, a maximum/minimum, or symmetry. Support it with your model, values, equation, or graph.
justify.evidence: Use your screenshot + one detail from your quick reflection.

transfer.lens: Explain when changing representation made a practical quadratic problem easier. Then use that choice on a new context.
transfer.evidence: Use your screenshot + one detail from your quick reflection.
